full_judgment: 8. This case appears to be clearly governed by the decision of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in the case of Shah Wali Vs. Ghulam Dim as reported in 19 DLR, S.C. 143. In that case the Supreme Court of Pakistan had to deal with the question of deposit of a certain amount of pre-emption money after the expiry of the date fixed by a decree in a pre-emption suit. The trial court directed the plaintiff to deposit a sum of Rs. 3000/- on account of the pre-emption money on or before 21st March, 1961 and it was further directed that in default of deposit by that date, the suit would be dismissed with costs. On an appeal against said decree the appellate court enhanced the amount of pre-emption money to Rs. 8000/- which was directed to be deposited within 1 month of the appellate decree dated the 30th March, 1962 in default whereof the suit would be treated as dismissed. A second appeal was filed to the High Court of West Pakistan but this appeal being treated as revision under an amendment of the relevant law was dismissed on the 9th of October, 1962. The pre-emption money as directed by the court was supposed to have been deposited by the plaintiff but it subsequently appeared that through a mistake in calculation the deposit made was short by a small amount. The question arose whether the court had any jurisdiction to extend the period of time after the suit had been dismissed owing to the operation of the default order. It has been held by the Supreme Court that when for the plaintiffs default in making payment of the correct amount within the time fixed by the appellate decree the suit had been dismissed, there is no question of extension of time involved either by the original court or by the appellate court thereafter, although in an appeal from the decree itself which has prescribed the time limit, such an extension can be granted by the appellate court hearing the said appeal Hamudoor Rahman, J (as he then was) in a separate judgment elaborated the reasons in support of the decision of the Supreme Court in the following words:-
